WITH train1_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT ON (datetime::date) datetime::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
    FROM
        public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 218
    ORDER BY datetime::date, time_of_data_entry DESC
), 
train2_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT ON (datetime::date) datetime::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
    FROM
        public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 219
    ORDER BY datetime::date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
train3_daily AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT ON (datetime::date) datetime::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
    FROM
        public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 220
    ORDER BY datetime::date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
train1_diff AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
    FROM train1_daily
),
train2_diff AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
    FROM train2_daily
),
train3_diff AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
    FROM train3_daily
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(t1.date, t2.date, t3.date) AS date,
    COALESCE(t1.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t2.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t3.daily_consumption, 0) AS "Total Daily Flow"
FROM
    train1_diff t1
FULL OUTER JOIN
    train2_diff t2 ON t1.date = t2.date
FULL OUTER JOIN
    train3_diff t3 ON t1.date = t3.date
WHERE
    COALESCE(t1.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t2.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t3.daily_consumption, 0) > 0
ORDER BY
    date;

WITH train1_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (datetime :: date) datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
  FROM
    public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 218
  ORDER BY
    datetime :: date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
train2_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (datetime :: date) datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
  FROM
    public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 219
  ORDER BY
    datetime :: date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
train3_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (datetime :: date) datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
  FROM
    public.user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 220
  ORDER BY
    datetime :: date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
train1_diff AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
  FROM
    train1_daily
),
train2_diff AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
  FROM
    train2_daily
),
train3_diff AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    GREATEST(daily_flow, 0) AS daily_consumption
  FROM
    train3_daily
),
total_flow_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t1.date, t2.date, t3.date) AS date,
    COALESCE(t1.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t2.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(t3.daily_consumption, 0) AS total_daily_consumption_flow
  FROM
    train1_diff t1
    FULL OUTER JOIN train2_diff t2 ON t1.date = t2.date
    FULL OUTER JOIN train3_diff t3 ON t1.date = t3.date
),
new_panel_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (datetime :: date) datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
          reset_value
      ELSE
          daily_power
    END AS daily_power
  FROM
    public.user_powermeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 216
  ORDER BY
    datetime :: date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
original_panel_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (datetime :: date) datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
          reset_value
      ELSE
          daily_power
    END AS daily_power
  FROM
    public.user_powermeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 217
  ORDER BY
    datetime :: date, time_of_data_entry DESC
),
new_panel_diff AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    GREATEST(daily_power, 0) AS daily_consumption
  FROM
    new_panel_daily
),
original_panel_diff AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    GREATEST(daily_power, 0) AS daily_consumption
  FROM
    original_panel_daily
),
total_power_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(np.date, op.date) AS date,
    COALESCE(np.daily_consumption, 0) + COALESCE(op.daily_consumption, 0) AS total_daily_consumption_power
  FROM
    new_panel_diff np
    FULL OUTER JOIN original_panel_diff op ON np.date = op.date
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(tf.date, tp.date) AS date,
  tp.total_daily_consumption_power / tf.total_daily_consumption_flow AS "Electricity Intensity"
FROM
  total_flow_consumption tf
  FULL OUTER JOIN total_power_consumption tp ON tf.date = tp.date
WHERE
  tf.total_daily_consumption_flow <> 0
ORDER BY
  date;

panels.title: Daily Energy Intensity VS. Totalizer Flow

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', datetime) AS month,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS consumption
    FROM 
        public.user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 216 
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(consumption) AS "New Panel"
FROM 
    monthly_data
WHERE 
    consumption IS NOT NULL AND
    consumption > 0 AND
    $__timeFilter(month)
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;

WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', datetime) AS month,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS consumption
    FROM 
        public.user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE 
        form_id = 217 
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(consumption) AS "Original Panel"
FROM 
    monthly_data
WHERE 
    consumption IS NOT NULL AND
    consumption > 0 AND 
    $__timeFilter(month)
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;

SELECT
    datetime::date AS "Time",  -- Keep the datetime field for time series functionality
    TO_CHAR(datetime::date, 'MM-DD-YYYY') AS "date",  -- Format the date as string
    CASE
        WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
            GREATEST(reset_value, 0)
        ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN daily_power IS NOT NULL AND daily_power > 0 THEN daily_power
                ELSE NULL
            END
    END AS daily_consumption
FROM
    public.user_powermeterreadingdata
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
      AND form_id=216
ORDER BY
    "Time";
